acceptable_references.label: Section 127
acceptable_references.reason: defines wrongful confinement which is the aggravated form

required_points: Section 126 defines wrongful restraint as voluntarily obstructing any person so as to prevent that person from proceeding in any direction in which that person has a right to proceed.
For example, A obstructs a path along which Z has a right to pass. Z is prevented from passing. A wrongfully restrains Z.
optional_points: Obstruction of a private way over land or water which a person in good faith believes he has a lawful right to obstruct is not an offence under this section.
forbidden_points: Wrongful restraint requires physical detention in an enclosed space.
